variants.briefing:
Need someone to snag some cargo for us. We were using an old Hathor PAF for dead drops, but a local gang has dug in and we can’t get our shit.

If you feel like kicking some ass, grab the cargo from the freight elevator at [Location] and deliver it to the freight elevator at [Destination]. 

From what I’ve heard this place is full of all sorts. Won’t be easy getting out stuff back, but that’s what we’re paying you for.

Just make sure you got a ship that can handle a [MissionMaxSCUSize] load, and try not to get shot in the process. A handheld tractor beam would also be smart to bring along. 

Stows out.

variants.briefing:
We’ve been using the old Hathor [Location1] and [Location2] as stashes, but it turns out some over-eager nullbrains sniffed them out and are trying to boost our shit for their own.

Luckily, the goods are still there - for now. We need someone to visit that PAF and OLP, grab our stuff from the freight elevators, and take it to the freight elevator at [Destination] where we should be able to keep it on ice. 

Here’s the list of what to grab. Don’t care what order you do ‘em in. Be sure to bring a ship that can store [MissionMaxSCUSize] at the very least. 

[MultiToSingleToken]

Make sure you’re ready to deal with whatever assholes you run across. A handheld tractor beam would also be smart to bring along. 

Stows out.
